text.en: Believes every point where f'(x) = 0 is a local extremum, without checking that the derivative's sign actually changes there — missing that f(x) = x³ has a stationary point at x = 0 that is neither a maximum nor a minimum.
text.et: Arvab, et igas punktis, kus f'(x) = 0, on lokaalne ekstreemum, kontrollimata, kas tuletise märk seal tegelikult muutub — jättes kahe silma vahele, et f(x) = x³-l on statsionaarne punkt x = 0 juures, mis ei ole ekstreemum.
